coordination.notes: content/skills/*.json was touched for the audioCueId field only -- one stable reference per presentation cue, mirroring vfxId per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md's stable-reference rule, and held equal by the validator to the cue's existing free-text audio label so the two cannot drift into two answers. tools/src/validate.mjs took one appended block plus that one skill-cue field; game/project.godot an appended autoload and an appended [audio] section. No Rust, no ui/, no battle/, no render/ file was touched: the API P6 and the surface call is documented in soundscape.gd's header, and the settings keys P5 should put sliders on are documented there too.

blocked: needs decision -- none. But the bridge does not project weather: ExpeditionState::weather holds S8's per-region WeatherState and godot_bridge.rs's state dictionary does not carry it. P3's card owns that hunk and this lane touches no Rust, so Soundscape reads snapshot.weather[region_id].condition when it exists and uses the named DEFAULT_WEATHER constant 'clear' until it does. Every one of the twenty triples is authored and tested; only the live 'storm' path waits on P3: not_run

One region only. content/world/ declares exactly one world_region, world.region.black_beach, so twenty ambience records is the whole cross product. The validator derives the region list from content/world/*.region.json rather than a second list, so a new region fails validation until its twenty records exist -- no region was invented here: passed

The card asked for AudioStreamGenerator. A generator fills a buffer on the audio thread while the sound plays and re-draws the same samples on every replay; the same parameters baked once into an AudioStreamWAV render each record exactly once, play from as many players as the scene wants, and are byte-identical run to run. That is what placeholder_synth.gd does, and its header says so and why: passed
